ValidationRule.description: mark Consumer Privacy Act Category required if CCPA Inquiry box is checked
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', NSP_Consumer_Privacy_Inquiry__c = True, ISPICKVAL( NSP_Consumer_Privacy_Act_Category__c , ""))
